reasons: The preferred level is fully satisfied on its operative terms: Affiliates and contractors are licensees, the licence is perpetual and irrevocable, and it is transferable to a successor; Vendor's ownership sentence is left intact.
The subscription-termination element is inapplicable here because the grant is an express fully paid perpetual Deliverable licence, so the condition is demonstrably absent.

Minimality fails: the edit rewrites the whole grant, expanding 17 words to 45 (ratio 2.65) with an 0.807 changed-character ratio, and adds scope the playbook position does not require (worldwide/royalty-free/fully paid, reproduce/display/modify/derivative works, business-purpose scope, and transfer to an Affiliate).

A tighter operator-level edit would suffice, e.g. "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on its behalf receive a perpetual, irrevocable licence to use each Deliverable, transferable to a successor under Section 13.3."
Intent is preserved: Vendor ownership is untouched, "Affiliates" and "Deliverable" are defined, and the Section 13.3 cross-reference matches the assignment provision cited in the comment.
